# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 S8, Anatolian regional steps of 1337-1343 (oe_s8_). Generated by gen_s8_anatolia.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES); this line writes no monthly hook
# of its own and takes no lock: it has no event for Byzantium. On 1344.1.1 the line closes (steps never reached: 2).
oe_s8_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_s8_off } }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1344.1.1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w1 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w1 value = 2 } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w2 value = 2 } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w3 value = 2 } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w4 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w4 value = 2 } }
            set_variable = oe_s8_off
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_s8_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
            oe_s8_world = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps W-1..W-4 (global variables oe_s8_w<n>: 1 done, 2 window passed without it; W-4 also
# 3 a human Eretna was asked, 4 declined). Only while the countries acted on are AI (decision 52); no pop-up, no lock.
oe_s8_world = {

    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w1 } var:oe_s8_m >= 5 }

        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w1 } var:oe_s8_m >= 12 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w1 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W-2 Malatya goes to the Mamluks
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w2 } var:oe_s8_m >= 13 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s8_m <= 24 oe_s8_w2_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_s8_wch_2 oe_s8_w2_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w2 value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_s8 W-2: Malatya goes to the Mamluks" } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w2 } var:oe_s8_m >= 24 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w2 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W-3 Dulkadir takes Darende
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w3 } var:oe_s8_m >= 16 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s8_m <= 36 oe_s8_w3_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_s8_wch_3 oe_s8_w3_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w3 value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_s8 W-3: Dulkadir takes Darende" } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w3 } var:oe_s8_m >= 36 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w3 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W-4 Eretna, sultan
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w4 } var:oe_s8_m >= 49 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_s8_m <= 84 oe_s8_w4_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_s8_wch_4 oe_s8_w4_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w4 value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_s8 W-4: Eretna, sultan" } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_s8_m <= 84 oe_s8_w4_player = yes } random = { chance = oe_s8_wch_4 set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w4 value = 3 } c:ERE = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_s8.4 } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_s8_w4 } var:oe_s8_m >= 84 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w4 value = 2 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. W-1: Aydin's treaty with Venetian Crete (9 March 1337); the consul takes up residence at Ayasuluk
# (Theologo). Opinions both ways with Venice and Crete; a human Venice or Crete keeps its own opinion.
oe_s8_w1_do = {
    location:ayasuluk = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_s8_theologo_consul years = 7 mode = replace } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN }
        c:AYD = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s8_bw_theologo target = c:VEN } }
        c:VEN = { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s8_bw_theologo target = c:AYD } } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CRT }
        c:AYD = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s8_bw_theologo target = c:CRT } }
        c:CRT = { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s8_bw_theologo target = c:AYD } } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W-2: from 1338 the Mamluks hold Malatya again (a peaceful transfer; how it happened is not recorded).
oe_s8_w2_do = {
    location:malatya = {
        change_location_owner = c:MAM
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_s8_malatya_frontier years = 10 mode = replace }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W-3: Qaraja of Dulkadir takes Darende from Eretna (1338-39), without a war.
oe_s8_w3_do = {
    location:darende = {
        change_location_owner = c:DUL
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_s8_darende_seized years = 5 mode = replace }
    }
    c:ERE = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s8_bw_darende target = c:DUL } }
}
# BYZ scope. W-4 for an AI Eretna.
oe_s8_w4_do = { c:ERE = { oe_s8_sultan = yes } }
# Country scope (Eretna). Coins and the Friday sermon in the ruler's own name: kingdom rank (vanilla then calls the
# realm a sultanate and its ruler a sultan, rank_kingdom_muslim), a modifier, and Cairo takes offence (an AI Cairo only).
# Run by W-4 and, for a human Eretna, by the hidden worker oe_s8.90; never from an option preview.
oe_s8_sultan = {
    if = { limit = { country_rank_level < 3 } set_country_rank = country_rank:rank_kingdom }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_s8_own_name years = 10 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MAM c:MAM = { is_ai = yes } }
        c:MAM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s8_bw_khutba target = c:ERE } }
    }
}
# Country scope (Eretna). The hidden worker oe_s8.90 (var:oe_s8_do): 4 the sultanate of oe_s8.4 a.
oe_s8_do_job = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_s8_do ?= 4 }
        oe_s8_sultan = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_s8_w4 value = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s8_do } remove_variable = oe_s8_do }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs). Not for options or actions.
oe_s8_log = { debug_log = "oe_s8 world=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_s8_world')|0] (ones Ayasuluk, tens Malatya, hundreds Darende, thousands sultan)" }
